item.title: FATAL FURY: CotW - Season Pass 2
item.description: - DLC 1 "Kim Jae Hoon", additional stage - DLC 2 "Nightmare Geese" - DLC 3 "Blue Mary", additional stage - DLC 4 "Wolfgang Krauser", additional stage - DLC 5 "Mr. Karate", additional stage - DLC 6 "Kenshiro", additional stage - Additional stages

item.title: Garden of Witches
item.description: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

item.title: Just Keep Fishing
item.description: A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish🎣

item.title: Last Breath 最后的气息
item.description: Last Breath is a tense side-scrolling shooter in a fungal-ravaged world, where humanity has become “Spore Zombies.” As the older sister Guan Jin, fight through the ruins to find your lost sibling. Scavenge, adapt, survive. But what awaits: redemption or a deeper nightmare?

item.title: Orb Breaker
item.description: A minimalist Bullet Hell. Shoot bouncing orbs at enemies, buy upgrades, and embrace the chaos!

item.title: RPG Developer Bakin
item.description: Zero programming required! A tool for anyone to create RPGs! "RPG Developer Bakin" is a tool that makes it easy to create various types of RPGs, adventure games and action games without any programming knowledge.

item.title: Shadows Over Loathing
item.description: Shadows over Loathing — a slapstick-figure comedy adventure-RPG full of mobsters, monsters, and mysteries.

item.title: Smack Talk
item.description: Say your moves out loud, trash-talk your friends, and fight to win. Smack Talk is a 1–8 player online PvP platform fighter where your voice controls your attacks. Call moves, land one-liners, and finish foes with wild ultimates.

item.title: STAR WARS™: Bounty Hunter™
item.description: Bring In Your Bounty, Dead or Alive

item.title: Tap Dungeon
item.description: Pixel-art isekai roguelike dungeon crawler! 5 classes, mix skills & items freely in turn-based combat across deadly random dungeons. Fight goblins, orcs, undead; collect artifacts, beat hidden bosses. Death = rebirth, endless builds await. Become the hero saving the kingdom!

item.title: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door
item.description: A 3D romance simulation game with point-and-click exploration and interaction with the heroine. The story branches into a pure romance route or a revenge route, leading to multiple endings.

item.title: Void Miner – Incremental Asteroids Roguelite
item.description: Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression.

item.title: Age of Empires II: DE - The Viking Sagas
item.description: Unleash the fury of the North and lead the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians into epic Viking battles.

item.title: Aggelos 2
item.description: With the Gods of light about to lose the great battle against the Army of Darkness, the Aggelos must learn to embrace his darker side. Explore two opposing realms full of secrets, puzzles and intense 2D combat in this challenging action-platformer.

item.title: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
item.description: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark!

item.title: Mimic Party
item.description: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

item.title: Mining and Dwarves
item.description: An incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Play actively for maximum gains, or idle and let the dwarves do the work.

item.title: Rewind 99
item.description: You're the last remaining video rental store. From humble VHS clerk to rental racketeer - run your video store and explore Reshoot Springs, building an underground empire. Expand with upgrades, side hustles, store membership, and more. Whatever it takes to survive - solo or in up to 4-player co-op.

item.title: Scott Pilgrim EX
item.description: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!

item.title: SHRIMP GAME: OVERKRILL
item.description: SHRIMP GAME: OVERKRILL is a solo or multiplayer third-person shooter RPG set in an abyssal realm. Pilot your SHRIMP platform to fight giant sea monsters, master elemental classes, and unearth secrets in a 6-person co-op campaign, or just krill your friends in multiplayer PVP!

item.title: Space Rock Breaker
item.description: Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree.

item.title: the cabin game
item.description: the cabin game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

item.title: The Infected
item.description: The Infected is a sandbox, first-person, open-world survival game. Build bases, craft, farm, hunt, and survive changing seasons. Choose whether to face the hybrid “Vambies” or turn them off for a pure survival experience.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack
item.description: The team behind YOU DON’T KNOW JACK presents FIVE guffaw-inducing party games in one pack! You’re gonna need more than one party for this. Your phones or tablets are your controllers! For 1-100 players!

item.title: Wargame: Red Dragon
item.description: The new reference in RTS at its best! The Wargame series returns to duty, larger, richer and more spectacular than ever before. In Wargame Red Dragon, you are engaged in a large-scale conflict where Western forces clash against the Communist bloc.

item.title: West of Loathing
item.description: West of Loathing — a slapstick comedy stick-figure wild west adventure role-playing game.

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Suite: Themes Reimagined
item.description: Fully immerse yourself in the world of flight with this digital soundtrack to accompany you on your aviation journey. This suite of 21 unreleased original pieces is inspired by popular trailer scores created by Finishing Move Inc. for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
